review_text: These earbuds are amazing! Battery lasts all day and the noise cancellation actually works on my train commute. Best purchase this year.
Right earbud stopped charging after 10 days. Customer support has not replied to my emails in over a week. Very frustrating experience.
Sound quality is decent but the case feels cheap and the lid doesn't click shut properly. Works fine otherwise.
Consistent grind size every time, super quiet compared to my old grinder. My espresso shots have never tasted better.
It's loud, louder than advertised, and it leaves a mess of grounds around the spout every single time. Considering returning it.
Good value for the price. Takes a bit of getting used to the dial settings but grinds well once dialed in.
The heart rate sensor gives wildly inaccurate readings during workouts, sometimes off by 40 bpm. Not usable for training at all.
Love the sleep tracking and the battery easily lasts 5 days. App is intuitive and syncs instantly with my phone.
Screen scratched after just two weeks of light use despite the so-called 'scratch resistant' glass. Disappointed.
Sturdy, quiet motor, and the memory presets are a nice touch. Assembly took about 40 minutes and instructions were clear.
Desk arrived with a bent leg and a support bracket missing. Had to chase support for a replacement part for three weeks.
Does the job well, a little wobbly at full height but otherwise solid for the price point.
Video quality is crisp even in low light, auto-focus is fast, and the built-in mic is surprisingly good for video calls.
Driver software keeps crashing on Windows, webcam disconnects randomly during meetings. Had to switch back to my old one.
Picture is fine but the included clip mount barely holds onto my thicker monitor bezel. Wish it came with a better mount.
Took this on a 5-day trek, straps stayed comfortable the whole way and the rain cover saved my gear during a storm.
Zipper broke on the main compartment within the first month. For this price I expected much better build quality.
Spacious and well organized, though it runs a bit heavy empty compared to other packs I've owned.
Finally sleeping through the night without neck pain. Wish I had bought this years ago.
Strong chemical smell straight out of the packaging that hasn't gone away after a week of airing it out. Returning this.
Comfortable enough but flattens out faster than I expected, might not hold up long term.
Charges my phone from empty to full twice over. Compact size fits easily in my jacket pocket.
Stopped holding a charge after about six weeks. Feels like a fire hazard honestly, it got noticeably warm just sitting idle.
Charges fast and the LED indicator is handy. A bit bulky but worth it for the capacity.
Adjustable brightness and color temperature are perfect for late night reading without straining my eyes.
Touch controls are unresponsive half the time, have to tap three or four times before it registers.
Sleek design, fits my desk setup nicely. Only wish the base was a bit heavier so it doesn't tip as easily.
Noticeable difference in taste from tap water, filter change reminder light is a great feature.
Lid cracked within the first two weeks of normal use and now it leaks all over the fridge shelf. Poor plastic quality.
Filters well but the flow rate is painfully slow, takes forever to fill a full pitcher.
Second pair I've received and both had static in the left ear. Something is wrong with the quality control on this batch.
GPS lock is fast for running outdoors and the battery estimate has been spot on. Really happy with this upgrade from my old tracker.
Motor started grinding and stalling halfway up after only three weeks. Support offered a replacement part but no refund option.
Hip belt padding is excellent for long carries, no chafing even after 8 hours on the trail.
Advertised as fast charging but my phone charges slower with this than with the wall adapter it came with.
